objectives.text: Find the card with one red plus that is next to a short blue house that is 3 tiles from a tall grey house.
Find the card with one orange diamond that is next to a tall grey house that is 2 tiles from a short red house.
Find the card with two green plusses that is next to a short blue house that is next to a tree.
Find the card with two blue hearts that is 2 tiles from a rock that is 2 tiles from a short blue house.
Find the card with one black star that is next to a short yellow house that is beside a tall grey house.
Find the card with two orange circles that is beside a short grey house that is beside a tall red house.
Find the card with one green plus that is beside a tall grey house that is 2 tiles from a short red house.
Find the card with two black plusses that is 2 tiles from a short grey house that is 3 tiles from a short red house.
Find the card with one blue square that is beside a tall blue house that is 2 tiles from a lamppost.
Find the card with one blue plus that is next to a short grey house that is next to a short red house.
Find the card with two green stars that is beside a tree that is 2 tiles from a short yellow house.
Find the card with one green square that is beside a tall grey house that is 2 tiles from a tall blue house.
Find the card with one blue heart that is beside a tall blue house that is 2 tiles from a short blue house.
Find the card with two red hearts that is 2 tiles from a short blue house that is 3 tiles from a tall grey house.
Find the card with one black diamond that is next to a short red house that is 2 tiles from a tree.
